description: The profiled-discovery generation fixture: gen schema generates a committed schema whose profiles bind its discovery grammar (the profile only, selected by the entry file name entry.kdl, binds grammar main with its path anchor root and star patterns; the profile audit binds none, and no default exists) twice into two scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical, and the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor loads the schema with the digest the reference CLI reports and reads committed data documents through its own typed reader, printing every item streamed and the reading's outcome, each exactly as vet data reports on the same inputs: with the anchor supplied through with_anchors, or through with_options carrying it, the entry document's $root/*.kdl import resolves under the inferred profile's grammar to both matched documents in portable-path-byte order, each read with its record before the entry's own, and the reading does not fail; a document no rule or default selects a profile for fails with KDLITH-SCH011 until with_profile, or with_options naming the profile, admits it; the import fails at its site with KDLITH-IMP005 when no anchor is supplied or when the named profile binds no grammar; and an anchor no grammar declares fails with KDLITH-IMP005 before any document streams

stdout-contains:
schema ok digest=5dac7d16f6267fb4
case anchored
  document inputs/entry.kdl
  import $root/*.kdl targets=[inputs/parts/a.kdl,inputs/parts/b.kdl]
  document inputs/parts/a.kdl
  record Thing name=alpha
  document inputs/parts/b.kdl
  record Thing name=beta
  record Thing name=top
  failed=false
case anchored-options
  document inputs/entry.kdl
  import $root/*.kdl targets=[inputs/parts/a.kdl,inputs/parts/b.kdl]
  document inputs/parts/a.kdl
  record Thing name=alpha
  document inputs/parts/b.kdl
  record Thing name=beta
  record Thing name=top
  failed=false
case unprofiled
  document inputs/audit.kdl
  diagnostic KDLITH-SCH011 invocation profile profile (none) is not one of the profiles schema survey declares
  failed=true
case profiled
  document inputs/audit.kdl
  record Thing name=audited
  failed=false
case profiled-options
  document inputs/audit.kdl
  record Thing name=audited
  failed=false
case unanchored
  document inputs/entry.kdl
  import $root/*.kdl targets=[]
  diagnostic KDLITH-IMP005 anchor root of grammar the active grammar is not declared or not host-supplied
  record Thing name=top
  failed=true
case grammarless-profile
  document inputs/entry.kdl
  import $root/*.kdl targets=[]
  diagnostic KDLITH-IMP005 anchor root of grammar the active grammar is not declared or not host-supplied
  record Thing name=top
  failed=true
case undeclared-anchor
  diagnostic KDLITH-IMP005 anchor other of grammar main is not declared or not host-supplied
  failed=true
